topography.project_purpose: Cross Chain Bridge. Structurally: 48 project-authored contract(s) across 9 chain(s); 8 ERC20 tokens; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 14 common project-authored base contract(s) (oftcore, oapp, oappsender). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
